page.overview:
Who is A Midsummer Night's Dream Characters?

A Midsummer Night's Dream has 20 named characters.

Duke Theseus - The Duke of Athens who recently won a war against the Amazons, and to reward himself for his victory is going to marry their queen Hippolyta.

Lysander - A young man of good fortune. He is in love with Hermia and is one of the victims of Puck's love juice. Lysander is one of the lead characters in A Midsummer Nights Dream.

Demetrius - A young man of good fortune. He also loves Hermia, she however does not have the same feelings towards him. He is also the object of Helena's affection. Demetrius is one of the lead characters is A Midsummer Night's Dream.
